question: Where is the nearest restaurant you encounter heading toward Sycamore Park, Medina, OH from UH Rainbow Babies & Children’s Hospital, Cleveland, OH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%UH Rainbow Babies & Children’s Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cleveland%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Sycamore Park%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Medina%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), path_distance AS ( SELECT ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) AS total_dist FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point s, end_point e, path_distance pd WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) + ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) <= pd.total_dist * 1.1 -- Allow for up to 10% deviation from the direct path ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
